title: HopDodge
description:
A rabbit named Hop braves the tutorial temple to find the secret to everlasting life. Unbeknownst to him, the secret is the eternal afterlife. He dies, goes to Heaven, gets sent to Hell, reincarnates and journeys through multiple lives to reach the goals.
Dodge is a skull that's been trapped in the garden of Heaven for thousands of years. He begs Hop to hit the red switch to free him and when he does get free, he destroys Heaven. Hop only has one option to continue, team up with this unlikely ally to find a way back to Heaven. Dodge on the other hand is looking for his bones.

opDo.

 

Key Features:

Top Down AND 3D platforming
Hop around on the back plane as Hop OR 
Jump and weave in the 3D platforming mode as Dodge

50+ Base Levels to play through
Solve puzzles, Avoid traps and obstacles, and explore 50+ different challenging levels

Create and Share your own levels
Using an in-game editor, build levels and contraptions to your heart's desire then share those creations online using Steam Workshop.

Multiplayer

Play the same level as your friend and see each other as ghosts and interact!
Or create an editor lobby and have your friends join you and create levels together.

If you don't get the game, Hop will get hit by car :c
description_short: Hop is a 3D Sokuban with platforming and puzzles. Dodge is a tough as nails precision 3D platformer. HopDodge is both. Design your own levels. Play with friends. Get to Heaven. opDo.
